basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and avid fingerboarder based in Portland, Oregon. I spend my days working as a software developer, crafting innovative tech solutions, and my evenings shredding mini ramps with my fingerboards. I have a keen interest in Android devices and often tinker with custom ROMs and mods. In my free time, I enjoy watching reality TV shows like Survivor and exploring loopring developments. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it provides to dive deep into my hobbies. I'm typically online after work hours, from 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a passion for technology that goes beyond my formal education. Much of my expertise comes from hands-on experience and self-teaching through online resources and communities. My interest in fingerboarding started as a hobby during college and has grown into a niche passion.
